theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by 
  have h_main : ∃ (i j : ℕ), i < j ∧ (u i = u j ∧ u (i + 1) = u (j + 1) ∧ u (i + 2) = u (j + 2) ∧ u (i + 3) = u (j + 3)) := by
    obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
    classical
    
    let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
    have h_finite : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
      have h_sub : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
        have h₄ := hB n
        have h₅ := hB (n + 1)
        have h₆ := hB (n + 2)
        have h₇ := hB (n + 3)
        simp only at h₄ h₅ h₆ h₇ ⊢
        constructor <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try simp_all only [and_self, f]) 
      
      have h_fin_Icc : Set.Finite (Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)) := by
        apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)))
        intro x hx
        simp_all only [ge_iff_le, ne_eq, mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc, mem_setOf_eq, and_self]
        
      exact Set.Finite.subset h_fin_Icc h_sub
    
    have h_pigeon : ∃ (i j : ℕ), i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
      by_contra! h₄
      have h_inj : Function.Injective f := by
        intro i j h₆
        by_cases h₇ : i = j
        · exact h₇
        · have h₈ : i < j ∨ j < i := by omega
          cases h₈ with
          | inl h₈ =>
            simp_all only
          | inr h₈ =>
            tauto
      have h_inf : Set.Infinite (Set.range f) := Set.infinite_range_of_injective h_inj
      exact Set.not_infinite.mpr h_finite h_inf
    
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h_pigeon
    refine' ⟨i, j, hij, _⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, f] at h_eq ⊢
    <;>
    (try exact h_eq)
  
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h_main
  have h₁ : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    have h₂ : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
      intro m
      induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h m ih =>
        match m with
        | 0 =>
          exact h_eq.1
        | 1 =>
          have h₃ := h_eq.2.1
          assumption
        | 2 =>
          have h₃ := h_eq.2.2.1
          omega
        | 3 =>
          have h₃ := h_eq.2.2.2
          assumption
        | m + 4 =>
          have h₄ : u (i + (m + 4)) = ((u (i + (m + 4) - 1) + u (i + (m + 4) - 2) + u (i + (m + 4) - 3) * u (i + (m + 4) - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (i + (m + 4) - 1) * u (i + (m + 4) - 2) + u (i + (m + 4) - 3) + u (i + (m + 4) - 4)) := by
            have h₅ := hu (i + (m + 4)) (by omega)
            have h₆ := h₅.1
            norm_cast at h₆ ⊢
          have h₅ : u (j + (m + 4)) = ((u (j + (m + 4) - 1) + u (j + (m + 4) - 2) + u (j + (m + 4) - 3) * u (j + (m + 4) - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (j + (m + 4) - 1) * u (j + (m + 4) - 2) + u (j + (m + 4) - 3) + u (j + (m + 4) - 4)) := by
            have h₆ := hu (j + (m + 4)) (by omega)
            have h₇ := h₆.1
            norm_cast at h₇ ⊢
          
          have h₇ : (i + (m + 4) - 2 : ℕ) = i + (m + 2) := by rfl
          have h₈ : (i + (m + 4) - 3 : ℕ) = i + (m + 1) := by exact rfl
          have h₉ : (i + (m + 4) - 4 : ℕ) = i + m := by omega
          
          have h₁₁ : (j + (m + 4) - 2 : ℕ) = j + (m + 2) := by omega
          have h₁₂ : (j + (m + 4) - 3 : ℕ) = j + (m + 1) := by omega
          have h₁₃ : (j + (m + 4) - 4 : ℕ) = j + m := by omega
          
          have h₁₈ : (u (i + (m + 4)) : ℝ) = (u (j + (m + 4)) : ℝ) := by
            rw []
            simp only at *
            norm_cast at *
            <;>
            (try simp_all only [Nat.add_succ_sub_one, add_lt_add_iff_left, Nat.lt_add_one, Nat.reduceLT, lt_add_iff_pos_right])    
          norm_cast at h₁₈ ⊢
           
    exact h₂ m
  use i, (j - i)
  have h₃ : j - i > 0 := by omega
  constructor
  · exact h₃
  · intro n hn
    have h₅ : u (i + (n - i)) = u (j + (n - i)) := by
      have h₆ := h₁ (n - i)
      assumption
      <;> omega
    have h₆ : i + (n - i) = n := by omega
    have h₇ : j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) := by omega
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    rw [h₇] at h₅
    exact id (Eq.symm h₅)
